profile.name: Tommy Reardon
profile.title: Robotics Engineer
profile.bio: I'm an engineer driven by a passion for bringing ideas to life — from early concept through to a finished, market-ready product. With a background in Robotics Engineering, I thrive in hands-on environments where I can design, build, and iterate on real physical systems.

education.notes: GPA focus on embedded systems, mechanical design, and robotics

experience.description: Leading mechanical design for a startup's flagship concussion-detection helmet system as part of WPI's Major Qualifying Project.
highlights: Designed iteratively and prototyped sensor and electronics enclosures, progressing through 9 SolidWorks iterations using 3D printing
Reconfigured helmet wiring and internal electronics to integrate cameras, sensors, and power systems in collaboration with electrical and biomedical engineering teammates
Conducted durability, stability, and usability testing on enclosures, battery systems, and sensors, validating video output and system performance

experience.description: Coordinated a four-person team to study pedestrian navigation patterns across different times of day in Venice.
highlights: Analyzed movement trends to develop recommendations for street usage aimed at reducing tourist congestion
Presented research findings and recommendations to local stakeholders using clear, data-driven visual presentations

projects.title: Concussion Detection Helmet
projects.description: Designed and prototyped a sensor-integrated helmet system for detecting concussions in real time during contact sports. Sole mechanical designer on WPI MQP in partnership with startup HeadVantage. Progressed through 9 enclosure iterations and 4 head mount iterations using SolidWorks and 3D printing.

projects.title: Autonomous Fruit-Picking Robot
projects.description: Collaborated with a team of three to design and build an autonomous robot capable of navigating a simulated orchard environment, identifying colored fruit, and sorting it accordingly. Developed an omnidirectional drive system and programmed vision-based fruit detection and sorting logic.

projects.title: Navigating Robot
projects.description: Worked with a team of three to program a robot capable of autonomously navigating a maze using multiple sensor inputs. Implemented C++ software that fused camera and LiDAR data to detect visual tags and make directional decisions in real time. Integrated gyroscope data to improve navigation accuracy.

projects.title: Microcontroller Programming
projects.description: Programmed a Raspberry Pi Pico W using C/C++ in a Linux-based virtual machine, completing embedded systems projects involving GPIO control, motor actuation, sensor integration, and real-time data display. Created detailed circuit diagrams in KiCad for each project.

projects.title: Streets of Venice — IQP
projects.description: Coordinated a four-person team to study pedestrian navigation patterns across different times of day in Venice, Italy. Developed data-driven recommendations for reducing tourist congestion presented to local stakeholders.
